pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
Asha Foundation works with 200 villages to give children education, nutrition and healthcare. 92% of every donation reaches the ground.

Our story

Asha Foundation started with a simple idea: every child deserves a chance. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
Asha Foundation respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.page_body: By using the Asha Foundation website you agree to use it lawfully. Content is for general information and may change without notice.
